mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during late-cycle expansions with low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production growth rate signals a weakening supply environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when industrial production growth rate declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts exceed 1000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, combined with a weak increase in payroll employment, signals a slack labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during early-cycle contractions with high unemployment and weak payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when retail sales exceed 400000 (t-test p > 0.05).
